description:
Cast a copy of Lightning Bolt from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Emeritus of Conflict.
Displacer Kitten and Electro both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Biblioplex Tomekeeper triggers when it enters, preparing Emeritus of Conflict.
Resolve the remaining trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.
